_why: Needles whose anchor matches their target MORE THAN ONCE. Every harness in
this directory refuses such a mutant as HARNESS-FAIL, so each line here is a
mutant that DOES NOT RUN — the battery's denominator counts it and its power
does not. Seven of them were discovered the day this check was added
(CERT-563) and they belong to four different lanes' harnesses, so failing on
them immediately would have taken master red on debt nobody here owns.
This is therefore a RATCHET, the same shape as frontend/typecheck-baseline.json:
anything not listed here fails the scan. Fixing one prints a nudge and does not
fail, because blocking a lane for repairing a guard would be perverse.
To clear an entry: make the needle unique (usually by extending it with the
next line that differs), confirm the harness scores the mutant KILLED rather
than HARNESS-FAIL, and delete the line. Tracked on the issue below.
